author: Ellen Perera
text: Kevin from Flush Drains is the best plumber we have ever met. He is knowledgeable, experienced and honest. You can trust him. Just excellent!!

author: Brian Perera
text:
Prompt, courteous, and professional service.

We had an appliance to be installed and were informed that we needed a plumbing upgrade in order to connect. Flush Drains was there early the next day and fixed what we needed immediately at a very reasonable price.

We will have them on our plumbing and drain speed dial! Great work.

author: Mona
text: We love Flush Drain!  Kevin will explain what needs to be done and if there options that he can do to reducethecost.  We trust them to do what is needed and will always call them.

author: Amy Morse
text: I've been using Flush Drains as my go to for plumbing services for several years now. They are honest, friendly, hard-working and reasonably priced. I highly recommend.

author: Akin Awosika
text: A great combination of well mannered and highly skilled plumbers. These guys really go over and beyond. They totally renovated 2 bathrooms in my home and did a fantastic job, managing the dust and keeping the work site very clean and delivering a fantastic finished product. I would recommend these guys to anyone again and again.
